end.summary:
Discussed “unity in diversity” and how differences can enrich society.
Identified examples of diversity in festivals, language, food and dress, including Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti and phiran.
Practised finding shared features and values such as kindness, sharing and hospitality.
Diversity-as-weakness misconception remained; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity through songs, festivals, clothing, food and shared values. They gave several relevant examples and explored how different skills can help people solve problems together. They still mixed up diversity with possible conflict, and this was not fully corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, ask Riya to make a two-column list of differences and ways those differences can help a community.
